_readme: Organize ALL app content in this shape. One file per topic in /content/topics/. Claude Code should migrate the existing Streamlit content into this format. This structure is what makes the app feel 'organised' — every topic knows its class, exam relevance, chapters, and questions.

chapters.title: Hybridization
chapters.summary: One-paragraph plain-language overview shown at the top of the chapter.

sections.heading: What is hybridization?
sections.body: Markdown text. Formulas written as CH~3~COOH style or LaTeX, rendered with proper subscripts.
sections.key_point: Optional one-line callout shown in a highlighted card.

molecule.name: Benzene
molecule.about: Benzene is a cyclic aromatic hydrocarbon with a planar structure.
molecule.structure_source: pubchem_cid or embedded SDF/mol block for 3Dmol.js

reaction.explanation: Acetic acid reacts with sodium bicarbonate to form sodium acetate, water and carbon dioxide.

steps.title: Attack on aromatic ring
steps.explanation: The electrophile attacks the electron-rich benzene ring, forming a sigma complex.
steps.key_point: The aromaticity is temporarily lost in this step.

question.prompt: What is the hybridization of carbon in ethyne (C2H2)?
question.explanation: Each carbon in ethyne forms 2 sigma bonds and 2 pi bonds, so it is sp hybridized.

user_progress_shape._note: Stored per user (backend or local). Drives the dashboard stats.
